## What changes and why it helps older users

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint:html` and `python tools/validate.py` pass
- [ ] Texts exist in Kazakh, Russian and English
- [ ] No surveillance, no network calls, no dark patterns (see GOVERNANCE.md red lines)

- [ ] Screenshots attached for visual changes
